wikibasefacetedsearch-description: Waxay xoojisaa [[Special:Search]] iyada oo ku daraysa awoodaha raadinta wejiyada badan. Shaandhee natiijooyinka iyadoo lagu salaynayo nooca instance-ka ama qiimayaasha bayaannada
wikibase-faceted-search-config-invalid: Isbeddelladaadii lama kaydin. Waxay ka kooban yihiin {{PLURAL:$1|khaladka soo socda|khaladaadka soo socda}}:
wikibase-faceted-search-config-tab-name-: Wax ka beddel ciwaanka tab-ka ee $1
wikibase-faceted-search-config-help-docu: Waxaad [[#ConfigurationDocumentation|hoosta aagga tafatirka ka arki kartaa dukumentiyada habaynta]].
wikibase-faceted-search-facet-any-select: Mid kasta oo ka mid ah qiimayaasha la doortay
apihelp-wbfacetsearch-summary: Hel wejiyada loo habeeyey nooca shayga ee weedha raadinta, oo ay la socdaan tirinta qiimayaasha ee raadintaas.
apihelp-wbfacetsearch-extended-descripti: Liiska wejiyadu waxay soo celiyaan ugu badnaan 100-ka qiime ee ugu badan soo noqnoqoshada. Wejiyada kala-duwanaanshuhu ma laha qiimayaal.
apihelp-wbfacetsearch-param-search: Weedha raadinta ee lagu helayo wejiyada. Waa inay ka koobnaataa shaandheeye nooca shayga ah, sida <kbd>haswbfacet:P1=Q1</kbd>.
apihelp-wbfacetsearch-param-namespaces: Meelaha magaca ee la raadinayo. Sida caadiga ah waxay noqotaa dhammaan meelaha magaca ee la raadin karo, si ka duwan <kbd>list=search</kbd>, kaas oo si caadi ah ugu noqda meel magaca ugu weyn.
apierror-wbfs-not-configured: Raadinta wejiyada badan laguma habayn wiki-kan.
apierror-wbfs-item-type-required: Weedha raadintu waa inay ka koobnaataa shaandheeye nooca shayga ah, sida <kbd>haswbfacet:P1=Q1</kbd>.
apierror-wbfs-invalid-search: Weedha raadintu waxay ka kooban tahay shaandheeye wejiyeed leh aqoonsi hanti oo aan sax ahayn.
